subject: english
title: Co-operate and Prosper
instructions: Literature practice for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

sections.title: Identify the following sentences as True or False.

questions.q: The farmers of Gujarat were rich before the co-operative was formed.
Sardar Patel assigned the task of organising the farmers to Tribhuvandas Patel.
The co-operative eliminated the middlemen who exploited the farmers.
Dr Kurien was born in Anand.
questions.note: He was born in Calicut on 26 November 1921.

questions.q: Dr Kurien is called the 'Father of the White Revolution'.
Dr Kurien received the Ramon Magsaysay Award for community leadership.

sections.title: Match the character (or speaker) with the description.

questions.answer: Verghese Kurien — the 'Father of the White Revolution'
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel — the 'Iron Man of India'

questions.right: organised the farmers into a co-operative dairy
questions.answer: Tribhuvandas Patel — organised the farmers into a co-operative dairy

sections.title: Read the passage and fill in the blanks.

questions.q: When Dr Kurien returned to India he joined the Government Dairy at ________.
He felt the job was not ________ enough.
He agreed to help Mr Tribhuvandas Patel set up a ________.

sections.passage: When he returned to India, he joined the Government Dairy at Anand in Gujarat as a Dairy Engineer. But he felt it was not a challenging job for him. So he agreed to help Mr. Tribhuvandas Patel in setting up a milk processing plant. This was how the Amul Dairy came into existence in Gujarat.

sections.title: Read the passage and fill in the blanks.

questions.q: Sardar Patel was determined to bring ________ into the farmers' lives.
He decided to organise them into a ________ force.
He wanted to give them a ________ source of income.

sections.passage: He was determined to bring prosperity into their lives. So, he decided to organise them into a co-operative force and provide them with a steady source of income. This task was assigned to Mr. Tribhuvandas Patel.

questions.q: Dr Kurien was born in ________ on 26 November 1921.
Dr Kurien made India the largest ________ producer of the world.
Dr Kurien established the NDDB and designed '________'.
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel is known as the ________ of India.

sections.title: Answer in one or two sentences (about 30 words).

questions.q: What is Dr Kurien rightly called?
questions.answer: He is rightly called the 'Architect of the Modern Dairy Industry' and the 'Father of the White Revolution'.

questions.q: What task was assigned to Mr Tribhuvandas Patel?
questions.answer: Sardar Patel asked him to unite the poor, disorganised cattle farmers of Gujarat into a co-operative and start a co-operative dairy unit.

questions.q: What did Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel determine to bring into the lives of the farmers of Gujarat and why?
questions.answer: He was determined to bring prosperity, because the farmers worked hard rearing cattle but remained poor and were exploited by middlemen.

questions.q: Why did Dr Kurien give up his government job?
questions.answer: He felt that the job at the Government Dairy at Anand was not challenging enough, so he agreed to help Tribhuvandas Patel set up a milk processing plant.

questions.q: How did the co-operative help the farmers?
questions.answer: It eliminated the middlemen who exploited them, gave them a steady income and half the profits as dividend, and taught them co-operation and marketing skills.

questions.q: What moved the heart of the Iron Man of India, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel? What did he do?
questions.answer: The poor plight of the cattle farmers of Gujarat, who worked hard but remained poor and were exploited by middlemen, moved his heart. He decided to organise them into a co-operative to give them a steady income, and assigned the task to Tribhuvandas Patel, which led to the Amul Dairy.

or.q: Who were the three people involved in uplifting the cattle farmers? What were their contributions?
or.answer: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel dreamt of the farmers' prosperity and planned the co-operative. Tribhuvandas Patel united the farmers and started the co-operative dairy, removing middlemen. Dr Verghese Kurien set up the processing plant, built Amul into India's largest co-operative dairy, founded NDDB and Operation Flood and made India the largest milk producer.

questions.q: Write a short note on Dr Verghese Kurien's achievements.
questions.answer: He helped set up Amul and developed it into India's largest co-operative dairy, protecting milk producers from exploitation and giving them half the profits. He founded the National Dairy Development Board, designed Operation Flood and made India the world's largest milk producer. He received the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan and the Ramon Magsaysay Award, and is called the Father of the White Revolution.
